title: Namaz Ke Doran Masjid Mein Zalzala… Kuch Log Bhagne Lage Aur Kuch Namaz Parhte Rahe #shorts
description:
video mein aap dekhenge ke log masjid mein sukoon ke sath namaz parh rahe hote hain ke achanak bhonchal (earthquake) aa jata hai. Masjid hilne lagti hai aur kuch log khauf ki wajah se bahar nikalne lagte hain.
Yeh manzar humein yaad dilata hai ke zindagi aur maut sirf Allah ke haath mein hai. Aise lamhon mein imaan ki asal aazmaish hoti hai.
Kya aap aise waqt mein namaz jari rakhte ya bahar nikalte? Comment mein zaroor batayein.
Islamic aur imaan ko mazboot karne wali short videos ke liye Azam Shorts TV ko subscribe karein aur video share karein taake paigham sab tak pohanch sake 🤍
Allah hum sab ko har aazmaish mein sabr aur imaan ata farmaye. Ameen 🤲
